lines.text: The LORD led Israel forty years in the wilderness to humble and test them, and fed them manna.
Israel's clothing did not wear out, and the LORD disciplines them as a man disciplines his son.
The good land has wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, and its hills are ready to be mined for gold.
When Israel builds fine houses and grows rich, their hearts will become proud and they will forget the LORD who freed them from Egypt.
The LORD brought Israel water from the Nile River in a waterless wilderness, and fed them manna to humble and test them.
